scope.market_definition: The gemstone market encompasses the trade and distribution of precious and semi-precious stones, involving various participants such as distributors, wholesalers, and retailers. This market operates globally, with a focus on sourcing, trading, and selling gemstones across different regions and platforms.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the movement of gemstones from suppliers to various market participants.
This layer includes entities that sell gemstones directly to consumers or other businesses.
This layer consists of companies that integrate gemstones into larger systems or partner with other businesses.

Our Story

# A *World-Leading* Miner of *Coloured Gemstones*

Gemfields specialises in the mining and marketing of emeralds and rubies from some of the finest
sources in the world. We are proud of our leadership position and continually work to improve the
awareness and delivery of responsible practices within our industry all the way through to the end
consumer. Our approach has always been progressive and unconventional. We are a young, dynamic
company and support raw emerging talent wherever possible, working with cutting-edge designers as
well as some of the most iconic brands. We are not afraid to do things differently when required.
* [ Discover More ][13]

## Journey Through Generations

The story of KGK Group began when Shri Keshrimalji Kothari embarked on a journey to Burma, trading
gemstones in India. His dedication and integrity set the foundation for a global presence. Shri
Ghisilalji Kothari expanded the vision, fostering innovation and excellence.

Today, under Mr. Navrattan Kothari, KGK Group has become a premium global brand, with Mr. Sanjay and
Mr. Sandeep Kothari continuing the legacy and the fifth generation, including Mr. Saransh, Mr.
Vedant, and Mr. Arnav, shaping the future.

[DISCOVER MORE][12]

## Businesses

KGK Group stands out with its vertically integrated business model, seamlessly connecting the entire
value chain from mines to retail. As a global leader in diamonds and gemstones, KGK Group provides
exceptional quality to customers worldwide.

KGK Group leads with a vertically integrated model, connecting the entire value

chain from mines to retail, delivering exceptional quality globally.

Welcome to the world of colored gemstones

GEMIF company specializes in wholesale and investment sale of natural colored gemstones, which are
valued for their rarity and uniqueness.
‍

We combine classical values with a modern approach.

## Work with us
* We are a young progressive company with proffesionaly educated gemmologists
* High quality & competetive prices of stones
* Direct source of gemstones
* Ethical and sustainable sourcing

## Our focus

We offer a wide range of gemstones, with a specialization in sapphires, rubies, alexandrites,
spinels, chrysoberyls, and other gemstones primarily sourced from Sri Lanka. Our inventory includes
both calibrated lots and exclusive gemstones of various sizes.

**EXPERTISE**
‍

Our team of experts plays an integral role in our company. With their extensive experience in the
industry and globally recognized gemological certifications, we rely on their knowledge. They have a
deep understanding of pricing, quality standards, current demand from international jewelry
companies, and, most importantly, they can guarantee the authenticity of our offered materials.

## Our story

As gemstone enthusiasts, we embarked on a journey to find the right suppliers directly in the heart
of the sapphire trade of Sri Lanka, where we discovered immense natural beauty. We also recognized a
great opportunity to collaborate with mine owners who genuinely prioritize ethical practices towards
their employees, supporting local communities and infrastructure.

**SUSTAINABLE MINING**
‍

We believe in sustainable mining practices, which is why we focus on smaller-scale mines that have a
minimal environmental impact compared to large industrial operations. The gemstones we offer mainly
come from smaller mines and companies located in the northern and southern regions of Sri Lanka.
These mines extract a smaller quantity of gemstones on average while maintaining respect for nature.
After the completion of mining, the sites are quickly restored to their original state.

Our Story

# A *World-Leading* Miner of *Coloured Gemstones*

Gemfields specialises in the mining and marketing of emeralds and rubies from some of the finest
sources in the world. We are proud of our leadership position and continually work to improve the
awareness and delivery of responsible practices within our industry all the way through to the end
consumer. Our approach has always been progressive and unconventional. We are a young, dynamic
company and support raw emerging talent wherever possible, working with cutting-edge designers as
well as some of the most iconic brands. We are not afraid to do things differently when required.

## American Institute of Gemological Research

AIGR, Inc.
Jewelry Appraisers Independently Serving Colorado and Beyond

* **Phone**
  (303) 420-2369

[AIGR sample diamond ring appraisal with precious metal and gemstone details.]

### [Jewelry Appraisals][13]

A jewelry appraisal identifies and evaluates a piece of jewelry, including a monetary valuation,
whether for insurance, estate, or other financial or legal purposes. Jewelry appraisals need to be
updated from time to time.

[Learn More][14]

[AIGR sample colored gemstone grading report with green tourmaline detail. ]

### [Gem Grading Reports][15]

Gemstone grading reports identify and grade a stone and include a plot of the stone’s natural
characteristics, but there is no monetary valuation given. As a result, a grading report never
expires. 

[Learn More][16]

[Gemstone and watch resource books for research and continuing professional development.]

### [Expert Consulting][17]

AIGR graduate gemologists have decades of experience examining a variety of gems and jewelry.
Therefore, we can help you classify your jewelry for estate distribution or give expert testimony in
legal cases.

[Learn More][18]

### Welcome to AIGR

The American Institute of Gemological Research (AIGR), Inc., is an independent gem lab serving the
Denver metropolitan area and Colorado front range. Our experienced appraisers will evaluate your
jewelry in our laboratory and provide printed appraisals. As a result of our professional efforts,
we guarantee that qualifications of our GIA Graduate Gemologists will be accepted by your insurance
company.

AIGR’s gemologists have provided jewelry appraisals in Denver for over twenty-five years. This
experience on top of our education makes us experts in the field of gemology with in-depth knowledge
of jewelry manufacturing and pricing. Therefore, we can provide you with peace of mind about your
jewelry and gemstones and can document their value.

We are here to help. AIGR does not buy or sell so that we remain an independent advocate for you.
Please call us at (303) 420-2369. We have appointments available Tuesday through Friday.

[Logos for American Gem Society Certified Gemologist Appraiser and National Association of Jewelry
Appraisers.]
[United States map showing over forty states with AIGR clients.] AIGR has served clients from states
shown in red.

### Reasons for getting a jewelry appraisal

Do you want to know how much your jewelry is worth before you sell it?

Have you bought gems or jewelry online and need expert verification that you bought what was
advertised?

Did you inherit jewelry and need to know its value?

Have you purchased an item from an unfamiliar jeweler or pawn shop?

Are you a jeweler who needs certificates for your gemstones?

Visit this [website][19] for more information about gemologists and gemology

.

### Next Steps…

Please contact us with questions or to make an appointment.

[Rare Diamond Boston]

### **Loose Gem Wholesaler**

Welcome to Boston Gems, a wholesaler of fine colored gemstones operating in the Jeweler’s Exchange
Building in downtown Boston for over twenty years.

Boston Gems has an enviable collection of colored stones such as Sapphire, Ruby, Emerald, and many
more. Boston Gems also specializes in selling the highest quality Moonstone and holds one of the
largest collections in the country. Our inventory includes Indian Blue Sheen, Ceylon, Burmese, and
African Rainbow Moonstone.

We are committed to providing unmatched service, product, and knowledge to our valued customers.
Boston Gems has a commitment to fair trade practices and to disclosing gemstone treatments and
enhancements.

##### UNIQUE GEMs


### **What We Offer**

[[Ruby-Homepage]][13]

#### [Ruby ][14]

Ruby is the red to purplish-red variety of the mineral corundum that has been treasured by people
throughout the ages, and has been called the “King of Gems.” Ruby is known as a gem of power and
passion.

[[OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA]][15]

#### [Moonstone][16]

Moonstone includes several types of the mineral feldspar that show adularescence, which is a glow
that seems to hover and move over the top of the stone. This effect is created by light scattering
through the different layers of the gem. Moonstone is known as a gem of vision and intuition.

[[OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA]][17]

#### [Sapphire][18]

Sapphire is best known as the blue to violet-blue variety of the mineral corundum. However, it comes
in a rainbow of colors. Sapphire has been prized as a symbol of wealth and wisdom throughout the
ages.

##### gemstones

##### **Popular Stones**

## Emerald

Emerald is the green to bluish-green variety of the mineral beryl. It has been prized since the
times of ancient Egypt and was also treasured by the Incas in South America as a royal gem. Emerald
is known as a gem of love and abundance.

[Shop Emerald][19]
[emerald-shop]
[Tourmaline-shop]

## Tourmaline

Tourmaline is a mineral that comes in a rainbow of colors, sometimes within the same stone! It is
dichroic and will show different shades on different orientations of the crystal, so planning goes
into the cut in order to show the best colors of a faceted gem. Each color of tourmaline has its own
significance and meaning.

[Shop Tourmaline][20]

## Tanzanite

Tanzanite is the gem version of the mineral zoisite that shows a violetish-blue to bluish-violet
color. It was discovered in the 1960’s in Tanzania and was popularized by Tiffany & Co. Tanzanite is
known as a gem of transformation and optimism.

[Shop Tanzanite][21]
[tanzanite-wholesale]
[aquamarine-gem-boston]

## Aquamarine

Aquamarine is the blue to greenish-blue variety of the mineral beryl. It is name is related to the
sea “aqua” meaning water “marina” meaning sea. Aquamarine is known as a calming and protective gem.

[Shop Aquamarine][22]

## Opal

Opal is a mineral that is composed of hydrated silica spheres. The light scattering within the stone
causes “play of color” with bright flashes of different colors appearing as it moves. Opal is known
as a gem of luck and magic.

[Shop Opal][23]
[Opal-for-sale]
[garnet-shop]

## Garnet

Garnet is a family of related minerals that range in color from red to purple, and all the way
through orange and green. Garnet was a favorite gemstone for jewelry during the 18th and 19th
Century in Europe and is known as a spiritually grounding gem.

[Shop Garnet][24]

## Diamond

Diamond is known for its sparkle and is the cubic form of carbon with a dense structure, making it
the hardest gemstone. Diamonds were set in royal jewelry in ancient India. It is known as a gem of
faithfulness and commitment.

[Shop Diamond][25]
[diamond-wholesale]

## Peridot

Peridot is a green gemstone that is the gem variety of the mineral olivine. It has been used in
jewelry since the times of ancient Egypt. It is known as a gem of compassion and balance.

[Shop Peridot][26]

## Spinel

Spinel is a mineral that comes naturally in a rainbow of colors. It is a relatively hard stone
similar to corundum (sapphire) and red spinel was regularly mistaken for ruby until the development
of chemical analysis. Spinel is known to promote courage and optimism.

[Shop Spinel][27]

Who We Are

## Modern Jewellery Manufacturing with Traditional Craftsmanship

Casa Jewels is a Bangkok-based jewellery manufacturer located in Thailand’s Gemopolis Free Zone. We
combine precise digital production, skilled bench craftsmanship, gemstone expertise, and
international standards to create fine jewellery for brands, designers, retailers, and private
clients.

From CAD development and direct casting to stone setting, polishing, quality control, and gemstone
sourcing, our workshop supports both bespoke one-off projects and small-to-medium production runs.

[ About Casa Jewels ][184]

From CAD development and casting to setting, polishing and final quality control.

Natural and lab-grown gemstones, calibrated stones, recutting and precision sourcing.

Careful setting, refined finishing and detailed inspection for premium jewellery pieces.

Small-to-medium production for jewellery brands, designers and retail partners.

Gemstone Expertise

## Gemstones Are at the Heart of What We Do

Casa Jewels works closely with natural and lab-grown gemstones, from sourcing and matching to
calibrated layouts, recutting and production-ready stone preparation.

Our gemstone knowledge allows us to support jewellery brands and designers with stones that are
selected not only for appearance, but also for proportion, consistency and production suitability.

laboratory grown gemstones and diamond jewelry.

The Game

> Awaken as an explorer in a long-forgotten cavern teeming with untold secrets. In this
> award-winning, 1-8 player mining sandbox adventure, your choices shape an epic journey. Harvest
> relics and resources, craft advanced tools, build your base, and explore a dynamically evolving
> world waiting to be unearthed.

**[Core Keeper][101]** is an action-adventure sandbox game developed by [Pugstorm][102] and
published by [Fireshine Games][103]. It is currently available on Windows, Linux, PlayStation 4,
PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.

## Sedex Certified Jewelry Manufacturer to the SMETA 4-Pillar Standard

DWS Jewellery is audited against the SMETA 4-Pillar standard (Labour, Health & Safety, Environment
and Ethical Business), which impacts what happens at the factory on a daily basis vs. simply being a
formality for audits.

So when an international buyer is sourcing from a factory that has been SMETA 4-Pillar compliant,
then they can be assured that their compliance requirements will also be met and that the factory
would support responsible sourcing, working toward more transparency in their operations and
providing safe working conditions along their supply chain.

### Agreement with RJC (Responsible Jewelry Council)

Adhering to, and following the RJC Code of Practices ensures that our company implements systems to
track the silver, gold & gemstones to establish a systematic method for sourcing ethically,
respecting human rights, providing for the environment and operational transparency. We have clearly
defined supplier compliance and a stronger responsible sourcing story with the use of the RJC Code
of Practices for our gold vermeil and 9K/14K gold demi-fine jewelry.

### Indian Government Recognised Star Export House

DWS Jewellery is a recognised Star Export House by the Government of India. The company has an
exceptional track record in exporting products and developing an efficient quality export process
that has proven successful all over the world. DWS receives the benefits of being a Star Export
House, including faster and more efficient documentation and processing, and more reliable shipment
of goods due to its status as a Star Export House. At DWS, our experienced export team understands,
and is aware of, the international hallmarking Regulations and what is necessary to correctly comply
with the regulations for Jewelry being shipped to customers in all parts of the world.

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

# Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC

Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC is your trusted source for all types of fine jewelry and gemstone
valuations serving the Greater Los Angeles area, including the Inland Empire and Desert Communities
of California.

Whether you have fine gold and diamond jewelry, gemstones of every kind, modern or vintage
timepieces, pearls and precious metals, all your valuation needs can be handled expertly and
accurately at Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC.

Master Gemologist-Appraiser Teri Newman Brossmer has over 30 years’ experience in fine jewelry
appraisal. Her many credentials and continuing education have made her the most trusted source for
jewelry appraising in the region. Clients include private jewelry owners, insurance companies,
attorneys, Federal and State agencies, police departments, plus pawn shops and retailers.

* We are a young progressive company with proffesionaly educated gemmologists

## Our focus

We offer a wide range of gemstones, with a specialization in sapphires, rubies, alexandrites,
spinels, chrysoberyls, and other gemstones primarily sourced from Sri Lanka. Our inventory includes
both calibrated lots and exclusive gemstones of various sizes.

**EXPERTISE**
‍

Our team of experts plays an integral role in our company. With their extensive experience in the
industry and globally recognized gemological certifications, we rely on their knowledge. They have a
deep understanding of pricing, quality standards, current demand from international jewelry
companies, and, most importantly, they can guarantee the authenticity of our offered materials.

## Our story

As gemstone enthusiasts, we embarked on a journey to find the right suppliers directly in the heart
of the sapphire trade of Sri Lanka, where we discovered immense natural beauty. We also recognized a
great opportunity to collaborate with mine owners who genuinely prioritize ethical practices towards
their employees, supporting local communities and infrastructure.

**SUSTAINABLE MINING**
‍

We believe in sustainable mining practices, which is why we focus on smaller-scale mines that have a
minimal environmental impact compared to large industrial operations. The gemstones we offer mainly
come from smaller mines and companies located in the northern and southern regions of Sri Lanka.
These mines extract a smaller quantity of gemstones on average while maintaining respect for nature.
After the completion of mining, the sites are quickly restored to their original state.

Welcome to the world of colored gemstones

GEMIF company specializes in wholesale and investment sale of natural colored gemstones, which are
valued for their rarity and uniqueness.
‍

We combine classical values with a modern approach.

## Work with us
* We are a young progressive company with proffesionaly educated gemmologists
* High quality & competetive prices of stones
* Direct source of gemstones
* Ethical and sustainable sourcing

## Our focus

We offer a wide range of gemstones, with a specialization in sapphires, rubies, alexandrites,
spinels, chrysoberyls, and other gemstones primarily sourced from Sri Lanka. Our inventory includes
both calibrated lots and exclusive gemstones of various sizes.

**EXPERTISE**
‍

Our team of experts plays an integral role in our company. With their extensive experience in the
industry and globally recognized gemological certifications, we rely on their knowledge. They have a
deep understanding of pricing, quality standards, current demand from international jewelry
companies, and, most importantly, they can guarantee the authenticity of our offered materials.

## Our story

As gemstone enthusiasts, we embarked on a journey to find the right suppliers directly in the heart
of the sapphire trade of Sri Lanka, where we discovered immense natural beauty. We also recognized a
great opportunity to collaborate with mine owners who genuinely prioritize ethical practices towards
their employees, supporting local communities and infrastructure.

**SUSTAINABLE MINING**
‍

We believe in sustainable mining practices, which is why we focus on smaller-scale mines that have a
minimal environmental impact compared to large industrial operations. The gemstones we offer mainly
come from smaller mines and companies located in the northern and southern regions of Sri Lanka.
These mines extract a smaller quantity of gemstones on average while maintaining respect for nature.
After the completion of mining, the sites are quickly restored to their original state.

# The Gemstone Artist

**Welcome to the home of high-quality custom-cut gems – including natural, untreated gemstones and
certified gems.**

[gemstone artist at work]

**I’m John Bailey, and I provide faceting services for collectors, dealers, miners and museums
around the world. As [featured on the Travel Channel][83], I design and create custom gemstones and
jewelry. Whether you want to purchase a one of a kind piece of fine jewelry or to have an artist
help you design your own engagement ring, I’m here to help.**

**If you want to learn how to facet precious gems, you can follow this link to [Learn Faceting with
John Bailey at the International Faceting Academy][84].**

**If you are a faceter or lapidary artist and want to polish like magic, you can follow this link to
[get some of my own Voodoo Magic Faceting Polish][85]. It’s not a re-labeling of a commercial
product, but something I personally formulated and personally make.**

**Here’s my (former) world record largest flat-faceted flawless red Oregon Sunstone (click the image
for more details):**

[world record oregon sunstone]

**Here’s the kind of thing we do for our clients: This one-minute video shows some of the
progression of cutting a strongly-dichroic Oregon Sunstone – from showing the highly-directional
color – and some views that show how wrong cutting could turn the stone muddy (all the images are
the SAME stone) – to the pure and rich green that precise orientation and cutting can produce.**

**Working directly with the artist offers special rewards, especially when you want to:**
* **Design an engagement ring**
* **Create a special valentine gift for him**
* **Commission a unique gift for her**
* **Discover birthstone jewelry using custom-cut birth stones**
* **Imagine the perfect prom jewelry or prom gift**
* **Purchase an affordable engagement ring – custom made to perfectly fit both your feelings and
  your wallet.**

**I am well-known for my original designs, and can custom design a new cut for your special person
or occasion. I also mine much of my own material, and of work directly with the miners of Sapphire
and other fine gems, allowing me to offer certified natural treasures.**

* **Search for custom faceted gemstones on the [Gem Finder Page][86], where you can find gemstones
  by shape, search for gems by color, and buy gemstones by type.**

# [The Why Of The Cut][22]

Posted on [June 29, 2015][23] by [erma][24]

#### Gemstone Cuts and The Why.

Who does the cutting? What are the different methods of cutting? Ever thought why it is cut that
way?
What is a cabochon?  Why a Marquise?  isn’t that a Royal title such as Baron or Earl? ( Actually it
is a royal title that is lower than a Duke but higher than an Earl, if you are into Royalty.)

After delving into the history of gemstone cutting I have found some interesting answers.
A gem cutter is called a “Lapidarist” This trade is usually learned on the job, but there are
several colleges that do give courses.  How long it takes to learn, depends on the skill of the
student.

#### The different methods of cutting are tumbling, cabbing, faceting and carving.

**Tumbling**, the simplest method, is done in a revolving barrel with abrasives. Finer and finer
abrasives are used until the stones have the expected high sheen. This is closest to nature as the
same thing happens to stones in a stream. Of course, man made tumbling creates a much higher polish.

[[Rock Tumbler]][25]

Rock Tumbler

**Cabbing** is the cutting of cabochons, the most common form of gem cutting.
Cabochons are cut with a highly polished rounded or convex top, no faceting,and a flat or slightly
domed base. This cut is used for softer stones to safeguard them from scratching. It is also the
main cut for opals, turquoise,onyx, moonstone and star sapphire. Cabochons are not actually cut but
shaped and polished. they are much easier to produce than faceted stones witch have many angles.
They can be produced in any shape but oval is the most used.

This cut is used for star saphires and tiger’s eye stones to get the most of the design and
brilliance.

**The faceted cut** can be various shapes, where as the cabochon has special limits.
Facet is the cut but not the shape.  It is actually the shaping of many cuts to show the stone at
it’s best color and shine.

All natural stones including the rocks you might find along the edge of the road, have prisms or 
points of light that enhance their color. ( You might want to study an old rock just for the fun of
it.) Faceting was created to take advantage of that fact.

There are simple faceted cuts such as these step cornered aquamarine gems from the Smithsonian gem
gallery or the many faceted cuts shown here in this round brilliant cut.

[[Step Cut Gemstones]][26]

Step Cut Gemstones

[[Round Brilliant Cut]][27]

Round Brilliant Cut

This started in the 13th and 14th centuries. At a time when stone cutting machines   were being
invented to actually do the job. Before then, one would have to hire an artist to actually carve out
a stone by hand, which could take many, many hours. Today there are very few lapidary carvers. One
design that has been carved through the ages is the Cameo, which is usually cut from sea shells or
agate.

 

**The Marquise Cut**
The marquise cut is a thin oblong shape with pointed ends and is named after Jean Antoinette
Poisson, the Marquise de Pompadour……….. It is said French King, Louis the IV, asked his jewelers to
create a cut to capture his mistress’ smile

[[Madame Pompadour]][28]

Madame Pompadour

… For that interesting story go here..[http://www.ajsgem.com/articles/history-marquise-cut.html][29]

**A marquise has 57 facets.**

 

[[Marquise Cut]][30]

Marquise Cut

**The Princess Cut**
Then there is the Princess cut which is a square version of the round brilliant. **It has 76
facets.**

This cut is used for star saphires and tiger’s eye stones to get the most of the design and
brilliance.

**The faceted cut** can be various shapes, where as the cabochon has special limits.
Facet is the cut but not the shape.  It is actually the shaping of many cuts to show the stone at
it’s best color and shine.

All natural stones including the rocks you might find along the edge of the road, have prisms or 
points of light that enhance their color. ( You might want to study an old rock just for the fun of
it.) Faceting was created to take advantage of that fact.

There are simple faceted cuts such as these step cornered aquamarine gems from the Smithsonian gem
gallery or the many faceted cuts shown here in this round brilliant cut.

[[Step Cut Gemstones]][26]

Step Cut Gemstones

[[Round Brilliant Cut]][27]

Round Brilliant Cut

This started in the 13th and 14th centuries. At a time when stone cutting machines   were being
invented to actually do the job. Before then, one would have to hire an artist to actually carve out
a stone by hand, which could take many, many hours. Today there are very few lapidary carvers. One
design that has been carved through the ages is the Cameo, which is usually cut from sea shells or
agate.

 

**The Marquise Cut**
The marquise cut is a thin oblong shape with pointed ends and is named after Jean Antoinette
Poisson, the Marquise de Pompadour……….. It is said French King, Louis the IV, asked his jewelers to
create a cut to capture his mistress’ smile

[[Madame Pompadour]][28]

Madame Pompadour

… For that interesting story go here..[http://www.ajsgem.com/articles/history-marquise-cut.html][29]

**A marquise has 57 facets.**

 

[[Marquise Cut]][30]

Marquise Cut

**The Princess Cut**
Then there is the Princess cut which is a square version of the round brilliant. **It has 76
facets.**
With modern computers Lapidarists are creating more and more advanced designs for faceted gemstones.
For a more complete picture go to [http://www.e-jewel.co.il/en/gemstonesshapes.aspx?PageID=259 
 ][31]Very interesting.

[[Hope Diamond, most expensive princess cut valued at two million dollars!]][32]

Hope Diamond, most expensive princess cut valued at two million dollars!

 

Now with all the modern computer technology, the Lapidarist can create original cuts never before 
seen.  The Lapidarist artist would start with the anatomy of the gemstone, observing the natural
prisms in each piece, just as the stone carver would, then proceed to work his magic.

#####   Note:     If you would like to learn more about the “Hope” diamond check out my blog post 
##### under diamonds  “Famous Diamonds”  It has a fascinating history.   It even has a curse!

 

 

Until next time,

Enjoy your gemstones.

Erma

### The Atlantis Stone

Recently I was introduced to the “newest” gemstone. A beautiful blue stone I had never seen before.
Well it wasn’t new of course, no gemstone is new. The latest gemstone to be found in modern times by
modern geologists is “Larimar” the ” Atlantis stone”, also known as the “Dolphin Stone”. It is only
found in the Caribbean, natives have been using this stone down through the ages for healing,
divination and decoration.

[[ Larimar stones]][44]

Larimar stones

It was first discovered by modern man in 1916, Father Loren of the Barahona Parish in the Dominican
Republic requested permission to mine a certain blue rock he had discovered.

## Journey Through Generations

The story of KGK Group began when Shri Keshrimalji Kothari embarked on a journey to Burma, trading
gemstones in India. His dedication and integrity set the foundation for a global presence. Shri
Ghisilalji Kothari expanded the vision, fostering innovation and excellence.

Today, under Mr. Navrattan Kothari, KGK Group has become a premium global brand, with Mr. Sanjay and
Mr. Sandeep Kothari continuing the legacy and the fifth generation, including Mr. Saransh, Mr.
Vedant, and Mr. Arnav, shaping the future.

[DISCOVER MORE][12]

## Businesses

KGK Group stands out with its vertically integrated business model, seamlessly connecting the entire
value chain from mines to retail. As a global leader in diamonds and gemstones, KGK Group provides
exceptional quality to customers worldwide.

KGK Group leads with a vertically integrated model, connecting the entire value

chain from mines to retail, delivering exceptional quality globally.

Timeless elegance meets craftsmanship. KGK jewellery blends innovation with style and
sophistication.

**The Art and Luxury Behind Jewelry**

# Brilliant Life

### **MOQ**

Different types of gemstones have different minimum order quantities. So you can order exactly what
you need without overinvesting. We also offer custom gold jewelry, either as a single piece or as a
complete set.

### **Gemstone**

At Qinfa Jewelry,Customization is at the core of what we do. We offer a wide range of natural
semi-precious stones and synthetic gemstones, including glass and zircon, to suit your unique needs.

### **Jewelry** Plating Option

Qinfa Jewelry fine jewelry manufacturer provides different materials custom jewelry options, such as
elegance of gold, the versatility of sterling silver & brass, or the modern allure of stainless
steel and so on.

***A Quick Look at Our [Qinfa Jewelry Factory][14]*
**

## qinfa jewelry

As a leading gemstone manufacturer, we proudly craft exceptional gemstones that meet the highest
standards of beauty and precision. By combining advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and a
deep understanding of each stone’s natural properties, we consistently deliver products that are
both visually stunning and intrinsically valuable.

From sourcing and cutting gemstones to customization and final quality checks, we oversee every
stage with unwavering attention to detail. Moreover, whether you’re looking for one-of-a-kind custom
designs or large-scale production, we provide flexible, scalable solutions tailored to your brand’s
vision and evolving market demands.

Partnered with brands around the globe, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation while
upholding our core commitment to quality and artistry. Each gemstone we create reflects timeless
brilliance and expert care.

So why wait? Choose us—and together, we’ll bring your jewelry vision to life, illuminating the world
with beauty, one extraordinary piece at a time.

**Our Jewelry**

## Jewelry Theme

### Bamboo Leaf Bracelet Ring

This bamboo leaf bracelet ring combines natural inspiration with exquisite craftsmanship, showing a
unique elegance and fresh temperament

### Elegant zircon necklace

This elegant zircon necklace exudes captivating radiance, perfectly embodying the fusion of
sophistication and luxury.

### Vintage amber ring

This vintage amber ring showcases warm amber hues, unique texture and radiance, creating a perfect
blend of classic and modern design.

**CONTACT US**

## CNC cutting releases the purest brilliance of gemstones.

Whether it is complex shapes, unique designs, or standardized mass production, we can achieve it
efficiently, meet the personalized needs of different customers, and help create unique works.

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

* ### Welcome to Stuart Gems
  
  At **Stuart Gems**, we believe that gemstones are more than just beautiful stones—they are
  nature’s masterpieces. Founded by **Andrew Stuart**, an experienced gemcutter and gemologist
  (FGA), we are driven by a passion for craftsmanship and an unwavering commitment to quality.
  
  With years of expertise, we transform rough stones into stunning gems, revealing the unique beauty
  and brilliance hidden within. Every gemstone we offer is carefully cut and polished with
  precision, bringing out its true character and charm.
  
  As gemologists, we dive deep into each stone’s story, ensuring its authenticity and certification.
  We pride ourselves on complete transparency—so you can shop with confidence, knowing that every
  piece in our collection meets the highest standards of quality.
  
  Explore our carefully curated selection and experience the artistry behind every gem at **Stuart

and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing

levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### Welcome to

## The Gem Expo
## Your Destination for Crystals, Gemstones, Beads, Minerals & Handmade Jewellery

If you’re passionate about precious stones, crystals, gemstones, minerals, or artisan jewellery,
**TheGemExpo.com** is your go-to destination. From ethically sourced crystals, rare mineral
specimens, and rare gemstones to handcrafted gemstone jewellery, The Gem Expo show offers a curated
collection that brings the magic of the earth to your fingertips.

**Discover Unique Crystals and Gemstones from Canada and Around the World**

At The Gem Expo, we showcase a wide range of natural crystals, semi-precious stones, and minerals
sourced from Canada and across the globe. You’ll find stunning pieces from:
* Canada’s mineral-rich regions, including Ontario, Alberta, and British Columbia
* Brazil’s amethyst and quartz mines
* Madagascar’s vibrant labradorite and ocean jasper
* India’s healing stones, like moonstone, apophyllite, and black tourmaline
* Morocco’s desert geodes, vanadinite clusters, and selenite products

Whether you’re looking for polished points, raw stones, geodes, beads, or rare collector specimens.
Explore our collection to learn about different gemstone names and discover your favorites, from
beginner to expert.

Handcrafted** Gemstone Jewellery by Artisan Designers**

TheGemExpo.com is also home to a diverse range of handmade gemstone jewellery crafted by local and
international artisans. Each piece is thoughtfully crafted using genuine stones and sterling silver,
making them perfect for gift-giving, spiritual work, or personal style.
* Sterling silver gemstone rings, bracelets, earrings, and pendants with real gemstones
* Gem rings featuring aquamarine stone, tourmaline stone, and other precious varieties
* Birthstone jewellery personalized for every month
* Chakra bracelets and energy-clearing tools
* One-of-a-kind statement pieces you won’t find anywhere else

**A Trusted Name in the Rock and Gem Show & Mineral Community**

The Gem Expo gem show Toronto is the largest mineral and gem show, and is held three times a year.
The show brings together many trusted vendors, artists, and collectors.
* Authentic crystals, minerals, and jewellery from verified vendors
* Items curated by passionate collectors and gemologists
* New inventory with new stones and metaphysical tools is brought in every show
* Support small Canadian businesses and independent artisans with every purchase

**Start Exploring Today**

From healing crystals and chakra stones to beautifully crafted gemstone jewellery, from raw minerals
to beads, The Gem Expo is your trusted source for earth’s natural treasures.

Join thousands of collectors, crystal healers, and jewellery lovers who believe in the beauty,
energy, and story behind every stone.

**Sri Lanka Pavilion – Special for the November 27-29 Expo**

At the request of Raytronics Lanka Pvt Ltd (Sri Lanka) and International ASEAN Corporation Inc.
(Canada), The Gem Expo has designated a dedicated Sri Lanka Pavilion within the exhibition. This
special section will showcase and promote Sri Lankan gemstones, fine jewellery, investment
opportunities, Ceylon spices, and other value-added Sri Lankan products and services. The initiative
is intended to strengthen trade, investment, and business partnerships between Sri Lanka and Canada
while highlighting the quality, heritage, and global competitiveness of Sri Lankan industries.

### Our Story

The Rare Gemstone Company has been a leading miner and cutter of fine gemstones since 1974. Based at
the source of one of the world’s most exciting gem producing areas we are in the enviable position
to be able to select out the very best rough crystals as they come out of the mines.

With almost half a century in the industry, in-house cutting center and master cutters, close
connections with mine owners in East Africa and long experience running colored stone mines, we
offer a vertically integrated service from the mine to the end consumer bypassing the established
old chain of distribution and its many built in markups. Our extensive network of miners provide us
with the opportunity to have first viewing and selection of all new strikes and production from the
mines.

### [Jewelry Appraisals][13]

A jewelry appraisal identifies and evaluates a piece of jewelry, including a monetary valuation,
whether for insurance, estate, or other financial or legal purposes. Jewelry appraisals need to be
updated from time to time.

[Learn More][14]

[AIGR sample colored gemstone grading report with green tourmaline detail. ]

### [Gem Grading Reports][15]

Gemstone grading reports identify and grade a stone and include a plot of the stone’s natural
characteristics, but there is no monetary valuation given. As a result, a grading report never
expires. 

[Learn More][16]

[Gemstone and watch resource books for research and continuing professional development.]

### [Expert Consulting][17]

AIGR graduate gemologists have decades of experience examining a variety of gems and jewelry.
Therefore, we can help you classify your jewelry for estate distribution or give expert testimony in
legal cases.

[Learn More][18]

### Welcome to AIGR

The American Institute of Gemological Research (AIGR), Inc., is an independent gem lab serving the
Denver metropolitan area and Colorado front range. Our experienced appraisers will evaluate your
jewelry in our laboratory and provide printed appraisals. As a result of our professional efforts,
we guarantee that qualifications of our GIA Graduate Gemologists will be accepted by your insurance
company.

AIGR’s gemologists have provided jewelry appraisals in Denver for over twenty-five years. This
experience on top of our education makes us experts in the field of gemology with in-depth knowledge
of jewelry manufacturing and pricing. Therefore, we can provide you with peace of mind about your
jewelry and gemstones and can document their value.

We are here to help. AIGR does not buy or sell so that we remain an independent advocate for you.
Please call us at (303) 420-2369. We have appointments available Tuesday through Friday.

[Logos for American Gem Society Certified Gemologist Appraiser and National Association of Jewelry
Appraisers.]
[United States map showing over forty states with AIGR clients.] AIGR has served clients from states
shown in red.

### Reasons for getting a jewelry appraisal

Do you want to know how much your jewelry is worth before you sell it?

Have you bought gems or jewelry online and need expert verification that you bought what was
advertised?

Did you inherit jewelry and need to know its value?

Have you purchased an item from an unfamiliar jeweler or pawn shop?

Are you a jeweler who needs certificates for your gemstones?

Visit this [website][19] for more information about gemologists and gemology

.

### Next Steps…

Please contact us with questions or to make an appointment.

[Rare Diamond Boston]

### **Loose Gem Wholesaler**

Welcome to Boston Gems, a wholesaler of fine colored gemstones operating in the Jeweler’s Exchange
Building in downtown Boston for over twenty years.

Boston Gems has an enviable collection of colored stones such as Sapphire, Ruby, Emerald, and many
more. Boston Gems also specializes in selling the highest quality Moonstone and holds one of the
largest collections in the country. Our inventory includes Indian Blue Sheen, Ceylon, Burmese, and
African Rainbow Moonstone.

We are committed to providing unmatched service, product, and knowledge to our valued customers.
Boston Gems has a commitment to fair trade practices and to disclosing gemstone treatments and
enhancements.

##### UNIQUE GEMs


### **What We Offer**

[[Ruby-Homepage]][13]

#### [Ruby ][14]

Ruby is the red to purplish-red variety of the mineral corundum that has been treasured by people
throughout the ages, and has been called the “King of Gems.” Ruby is known as a gem of power and
passion.

[[OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA]][15]

#### [Moonstone][16]

Moonstone includes several types of the mineral feldspar that show adularescence, which is a glow
that seems to hover and move over the top of the stone. This effect is created by light scattering
through the different layers of the gem. Moonstone is known as a gem of vision and intuition.

[[OLYMPUS DIGITAL CAMERA]][17]

#### [Sapphire][18]

Sapphire is best known as the blue to violet-blue variety of the mineral corundum. However, it comes
in a rainbow of colors. Sapphire has been prized as a symbol of wealth and wisdom throughout the
ages.

##### gemstones

##### **Popular Stones**

## Emerald

Emerald is the green to bluish-green variety of the mineral beryl. It has been prized since the
times of ancient Egypt and was also treasured by the Incas in South America as a royal gem. Emerald
is known as a gem of love and abundance.

[Shop Emerald][19]
[emerald-shop]
[Tourmaline-shop]

## Tourmaline

Tourmaline is a mineral that comes in a rainbow of colors, sometimes within the same stone! It is
dichroic and will show different shades on different orientations of the crystal, so planning goes
into the cut in order to show the best colors of a faceted gem. Each color of tourmaline has its own
significance and meaning.

[Shop Tourmaline][20]

## Tanzanite

Tanzanite is the gem version of the mineral zoisite that shows a violetish-blue to bluish-violet
color. It was discovered in the 1960’s in Tanzania and was popularized by Tiffany & Co. Tanzanite is
known as a gem of transformation and optimism.

[Shop Tanzanite][21]
[tanzanite-wholesale]
[aquamarine-gem-boston]

## Aquamarine

Aquamarine is the blue to greenish-blue variety of the mineral beryl. It is name is related to the
sea “aqua” meaning water “marina” meaning sea. Aquamarine is known as a calming and protective gem.

[Shop Aquamarine][22]

## Opal

Opal is a mineral that is composed of hydrated silica spheres. The light scattering within the stone
causes “play of color” with bright flashes of different colors appearing as it moves. Opal is known
as a gem of luck and magic.

[Shop Opal][23]
[Opal-for-sale]
[garnet-shop]

## Garnet

Garnet is a family of related minerals that range in color from red to purple, and all the way
through orange and green. Garnet was a favorite gemstone for jewelry during the 18th and 19th
Century in Europe and is known as a spiritually grounding gem.

[Shop Garnet][24]

## Diamond

Diamond is known for its sparkle and is the cubic form of carbon with a dense structure, making it
the hardest gemstone. Diamonds were set in royal jewelry in ancient India. It is known as a gem of
faithfulness and commitment.

[Shop Diamond][25]
[diamond-wholesale]

## Peridot

Peridot is a green gemstone that is the gem variety of the mineral olivine. It has been used in
jewelry since the times of ancient Egypt. It is known as a gem of compassion and balance.

[Shop Peridot][26]

## Spinel

Spinel is a mineral that comes naturally in a rainbow of colors. It is a relatively hard stone
similar to corundum (sapphire) and red spinel was regularly mistaken for ruby until the development
of chemical analysis. Spinel is known to promote courage and optimism.

[Shop Spinel][27]

Who We Are

## Modern Jewellery Manufacturing with Traditional Craftsmanship

Casa Jewels is a Bangkok-based jewellery manufacturer located in Thailand’s Gemopolis Free Zone. We
combine precise digital production, skilled bench craftsmanship, gemstone expertise, and
international standards to create fine jewellery for brands, designers, retailers, and private
clients.

From CAD development and direct casting to stone setting, polishing, quality control, and gemstone
sourcing, our workshop supports both bespoke one-off projects and small-to-medium production runs.

[ About Casa Jewels ][184]

### Custom Jewellery Manufacturing

From CAD development and casting to setting, polishing and final quality control.

Natural and lab-grown gemstones, calibrated stones, recutting and precision sourcing.

Careful setting, refined finishing and detailed inspection for premium jewellery pieces.

### Private Label Production

Small-to-medium production for jewellery brands, designers and retail partners.

Gemstone Expertise

## Gemstones Are at the Heart of What We Do

Casa Jewels works closely with natural and lab-grown gemstones, from sourcing and matching to
calibrated layouts, recutting and production-ready stone preparation.

Our gemstone knowledge allows us to support jewellery brands and designers with stones that are
selected not only for appearance, but also for proportion, consistency and production suitability.

duplicating the conditions deep within the earth, his laboratory succeeded in growing the finest
gems over the course of a year’s time. A discovery so unique, it remains a carefully guarded
corporate secret to this day. Chatham is now recognized worldwide as the industry leader in luxury
laboratory grown gemstones and diamond jewelry.

## Sedex Certified Jewelry Manufacturer to the SMETA 4-Pillar Standard

DWS Jewellery is audited against the SMETA 4-Pillar standard (Labour, Health & Safety, Environment
and Ethical Business), which impacts what happens at the factory on a daily basis vs. simply being a
formality for audits.

So when an international buyer is sourcing from a factory that has been SMETA 4-Pillar compliant,
then they can be assured that their compliance requirements will also be met and that the factory
would support responsible sourcing, working toward more transparency in their operations and
providing safe working conditions along their supply chain.

### Agreement with RJC (Responsible Jewelry Council)

Adhering to, and following the RJC Code of Practices ensures that our company implements systems to
track the silver, gold & gemstones to establish a systematic method for sourcing ethically,
respecting human rights, providing for the environment and operational transparency. We have clearly
defined supplier compliance and a stronger responsible sourcing story with the use of the RJC Code
of Practices for our gold vermeil and 9K/14K gold demi-fine jewelry.

### Indian Government Recognised Star Export House

DWS Jewellery is a recognised Star Export House by the Government of India. The company has an
exceptional track record in exporting products and developing an efficient quality export process
that has proven successful all over the world. DWS receives the benefits of being a Star Export
House, including faster and more efficient documentation and processing, and more reliable shipment
of goods due to its status as a Star Export House. At DWS, our experienced export team understands,
and is aware of, the international hallmarking Regulations and what is necessary to correctly comply
with the regulations for Jewelry being shipped to customers in all parts of the world.

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

## Award-Winning Custom Jewellery Manufacturer India, Jaipur

Partnering with Brands & Designers Since 1999, Awarded for our exceptional quality & on time
delivery.

### Our Infrastructure & Handcrafted Mastery

Have worked with more than **400+ designers & brands **across **30 countries **and have been
consistently recognised for exceptional quality & on-time delivery.
* State-of-the-art **German Casting Plant & Machinery**
* Team of **950+ skilled craftsmen** & 100+ quality assurance experts.
* A dedicated team of **40+ Experienced CAD** professionals
* Engineered for a daily output of **6,000+ jewelry pieces.**
* State-of-the-art **German laser soldering & marking** machines.
* Equipped with **German plating** machinery & advanced **German XRF Machine**.
* Utilizing premium **German & Swiss plating Solutions** for exceptional quality.
* Extensive in-house gemstone manufacturing offering over **250+ natural & lab-grown gemstones.**

[Watch Our Factory Tour][58]

## Our Sustainability Promise

Crafting a Greener Future with Sustainable and Ethical handcrafted Jewelry

* A **Certified Green Factory**, upholding stringent environmental standards in daily operations and
  workplace conditions.
* A **Certified Sustainable Workforce by SEDEX-4 Pillar**, ensuring high standards in labor
  practices, health and safety, environmental performance, and ethics throughout the factory.
* **Certified Recycled Silver**, Verified by SGS, an independent team to reduce the environmental
  footprint to minimise harm to ecosystems.
* **Solar-Powered Energy**, our factory features a robust 120kW solar panel system, producing over
  186,782 kWh of clean energy annually by harnessing the power of the sun.
* **Advance Wastewater Treatment technology (STP/ETP)** is utilized to recycle and reuse water
  within the factory, significantly reducing overall water consumption.
* An **Advanced Waste Management System** to manage hazardous chemical waste, ensuring proper
  disposal to protect the environment.

[Watch Our Factory Tour][59]

### ***At Form To Feeling, our philosophy is straightforward: ****we believe in explicitly tailoring
### both the product and experience to you.*

Unlike most jewelry stores that only offer limited customization options, such as choosing a diamond
and a mounting, or making minor modifications to a predetermined design, we take a different
approach. When you choose to work with us, together we explore the best way to create your perfect
piece of jewelry, even if it currently exists only in your imagination. Our team has extensive
experience and knowledge in crafting unique, entirely custom-designed jewelry using the finest
quality materials available. No matter your budget, if you are searching for something truly one of
a kind, we have the resources necessary to bring your ideas to life. We understand that each
individual has their unique vision, and we are committed to realizing that vision in exquisite
detail.

# Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC

Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC is your trusted source for all types of fine jewelry and gemstone
valuations serving the Greater Los Angeles area, including the Inland Empire and Desert Communities
of California.

Whether you have fine gold and diamond jewelry, gemstones of every kind, modern or vintage
timepieces, pearls and precious metals, all your valuation needs can be handled expertly and
accurately at Gem Appraisals Unlimited LLC.

Master Gemologist-Appraiser Teri Newman Brossmer has over 30 years’ experience in fine jewelry
appraisal. Her many credentials and continuing education have made her the most trusted source for
jewelry appraising in the region. Clients include private jewelry owners, insurance companies,
attorneys, Federal and State agencies, police departments, plus pawn shops and retailers.

# The Gemstone Artist

**Welcome to the home of high-quality custom-cut gems – including natural, untreated gemstones and
certified gems.**

[gemstone artist at work]

**I’m John Bailey, and I provide faceting services for collectors, dealers, miners and museums
around the world. As [featured on the Travel Channel][83], I design and create custom gemstones and
jewelry. Whether you want to purchase a one of a kind piece of fine jewelry or to have an artist
help you design your own engagement ring, I’m here to help.**

**If you want to learn how to facet precious gems, you can follow this link to [Learn Faceting with
John Bailey at the International Faceting Academy][84].**

**If you are a faceter or lapidary artist and want to polish like magic, you can follow this link to
[get some of my own Voodoo Magic Faceting Polish][85]. It’s not a re-labeling of a commercial
product, but something I personally formulated and personally make.**

**Here’s my (former) world record largest flat-faceted flawless red Oregon Sunstone (click the image
for more details):**

[world record oregon sunstone]

**Here’s the kind of thing we do for our clients: This one-minute video shows some of the
progression of cutting a strongly-dichroic Oregon Sunstone – from showing the highly-directional
color – and some views that show how wrong cutting could turn the stone muddy (all the images are
the SAME stone) – to the pure and rich green that precise orientation and cutting can produce.**

**Working directly with the artist offers special rewards, especially when you want to:**
* **Design an engagement ring**
* **Create a special valentine gift for him**
* **Commission a unique gift for her**
* **Discover birthstone jewelry using custom-cut birth stones**
* **Imagine the perfect prom jewelry or prom gift**
* **Purchase an affordable engagement ring – custom made to perfectly fit both your feelings and
  your wallet.**

**I am well-known for my original designs, and can custom design a new cut for your special person
or occasion. I also mine much of my own material, and of work directly with the miners of Sapphire
and other fine gems, allowing me to offer certified natural treasures.**

**Find the gemstone art and jewelry you want:**
* **Search for custom faceted gemstones on the [Gem Finder Page][86], where you can find gemstones
  by shape, search for gems by color, and buy gemstones by type.**
* **Find designer jewelry made with custom cut gemstones on the[ Designer Jewelry page][87].**

# [The Why Of The Cut][22]

Posted on [June 29, 2015][23] by [erma][24]

#### Gemstone Cuts and The Why.

Who does the cutting? What are the different methods of cutting? Ever thought why it is cut that
way?
What is a cabochon?  Why a Marquise?  isn’t that a Royal title such as Baron or Earl? ( Actually it
is a royal title that is lower than a Duke but higher than an Earl, if you are into Royalty.)

After delving into the history of gemstone cutting I have found some interesting answers.
A gem cutter is called a “Lapidarist” This trade is usually learned on the job, but there are
several colleges that do give courses.  How long it takes to learn, depends on the skill of the
student.

#### The different methods of cutting are tumbling, cabbing, faceting and carving.

**Tumbling**, the simplest method, is done in a revolving barrel with abrasives. Finer and finer
abrasives are used until the stones have the expected high sheen. This is closest to nature as the
same thing happens to stones in a stream. Of course, man made tumbling creates a much higher polish.

[[Rock Tumbler]][25]

Rock Tumbler

**Cabbing** is the cutting of cabochons, the most common form of gem cutting.
Cabochons are cut with a highly polished rounded or convex top, no faceting,and a flat or slightly
domed base. This cut is used for softer stones to safeguard them from scratching. It is also the
main cut for opals, turquoise,onyx, moonstone and star sapphire. Cabochons are not actually cut but
shaped and polished. they are much easier to produce than faceted stones witch have many angles.
They can be produced in any shape but oval is the most used.

This cut is used for star saphires and tiger’s eye stones to get the most of the design and
brilliance.

**The faceted cut** can be various shapes, where as the cabochon has special limits.
Facet is the cut but not the shape.  It is actually the shaping of many cuts to show the stone at
it’s best color and shine.

All natural stones including the rocks you might find along the edge of the road, have prisms or 
points of light that enhance their color. ( You might want to study an old rock just for the fun of
it.) Faceting was created to take advantage of that fact.

There are simple faceted cuts such as these step cornered aquamarine gems from the Smithsonian gem
gallery or the many faceted cuts shown here in this round brilliant cut.

[[Step Cut Gemstones]][26]

Step Cut Gemstones

[[Round Brilliant Cut]][27]

Round Brilliant Cut

This started in the 13th and 14th centuries. At a time when stone cutting machines   were being
invented to actually do the job. Before then, one would have to hire an artist to actually carve out
a stone by hand, which could take many, many hours. Today there are very few lapidary carvers. One
design that has been carved through the ages is the Cameo, which is usually cut from sea shells or
agate.

 

**The Marquise Cut**
The marquise cut is a thin oblong shape with pointed ends and is named after Jean Antoinette
Poisson, the Marquise de Pompadour……….. It is said French King, Louis the IV, asked his jewelers to
create a cut to capture his mistress’ smile

[[Madame Pompadour]][28]

Madame Pompadour

… For that interesting story go here..[http://www.ajsgem.com/articles/history-marquise-cut.html][29]

**A marquise has 57 facets.**

 

[[Marquise Cut]][30]

Marquise Cut

**The Princess Cut**
Then there is the Princess cut which is a square version of the round brilliant. **It has 76
facets.**

# [The Atlantis Stone][41]

Posted on [May 19, 2015][42] by [erma][43]

### The Atlantis Stone

Recently I was introduced to the “newest” gemstone. A beautiful blue stone I had never seen before.
Well it wasn’t new of course, no gemstone is new. The latest gemstone to be found in modern times by
modern geologists is “Larimar” the ” Atlantis stone”, also known as the “Dolphin Stone”. It is only
found in the Caribbean, natives have been using this stone down through the ages for healing,
divination and decoration.

[[ Larimar stones]][44]

Larimar stones

It was first discovered by modern man in 1916, Father Loren of the Barahona Parish in the Dominican
Republic requested permission to mine a certain blue rock he had discovered.

**The Art and Luxury Behind Jewelry**

# Brilliant Life

### **MOQ**

Different types of gemstones have different minimum order quantities. So you can order exactly what
you need without overinvesting. We also offer custom gold jewelry, either as a single piece or as a
complete set.

### **Gemstone**

At Qinfa Jewelry,Customization is at the core of what we do. We offer a wide range of natural
semi-precious stones and synthetic gemstones, including glass and zircon, to suit your unique needs.

### **Jewelry** Plating Option

Qinfa Jewelry fine jewelry manufacturer provides different materials custom jewelry options, such as
elegance of gold, the versatility of sterling silver & brass, or the modern allure of stainless
steel and so on.

***A Quick Look at Our [Qinfa Jewelry Factory][14]*
**

## qinfa jewelry

As a leading gemstone manufacturer, we proudly craft exceptional gemstones that meet the highest
standards of beauty and precision. By combining advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship and a
deep understanding of each stone’s natural properties, we consistently deliver products that are
both visually stunning and intrinsically valuable.

From sourcing and cutting gemstones to customization and final quality checks, we oversee every
stage with unwavering attention to detail. Moreover, whether you’re looking for one-of-a-kind custom
designs or large-scale production, we provide flexible, scalable solutions tailored to your brand’s
vision and evolving market demands.

Partnered with brands around the globe, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation while
upholding our core commitment to quality and artistry. Each gemstone we create reflects timeless
brilliance and expert care.

So why wait? Choose us—and together, we’ll bring your jewelry vision to life, illuminating the world
with beauty, one extraordinary piece at a time.

**Our Jewelry**

## Jewelry Theme

### Bamboo Leaf Bracelet Ring

This bamboo leaf bracelet ring combines natural inspiration with exquisite craftsmanship, showing a
unique elegance and fresh temperament

### Elegant zircon necklace

This elegant zircon necklace exudes captivating radiance, perfectly embodying the fusion of
sophistication and luxury.

### Vintage amber ring

This vintage amber ring showcases warm amber hues, unique texture and radiance, creating a perfect
blend of classic and modern design.

**CONTACT US**

## CNC cutting releases the purest brilliance of gemstones.

Whether it is complex shapes, unique designs, or standardized mass production, we can achieve it
efficiently, meet the personalized needs of different customers, and help create unique works.

## Gemstone Rough Sourcing

Our gemstones are sourced through a responsible and transparent procurement process from trusted
mines, suppliers, and trading partners. We prioritise ethical sourcing practices, ensuring
compliance with applicable regulations, traceability standards, and sustainable business principles.

## Rough Selection & Sorting

After sourcing, gemstones are carefully sorted based on color, clarity, size, shape, quality,
inclusions, and transparency. Each stone is assessed for its cutting potential and categorized
accordingly, ensuring efficient processing and consistent quality throughout the manufacturing
process. Low-quality gemstones are separated from premium-grade material.

## Cutting & Shaping

Selected rough gemstones are carefully cut and shaped by skilled artisans to maximize their natural
beauty and value. Each stone is processed with precision to achieve the desired shape, symmetry, and
proportions while preserving its quality and enhancing its potential for brilliance.

## Facets & Polished

Following the cutting and shaping process, gemstones are expertly faceted to enhance their
brilliance and light reflection, with careful attention to symmetry and proportions. They are then
polished to achieve a smooth, high-lustre finish, revealing their natural beauty and ensuring a
premium-quality appearance.

## Quality Check

Upon completion of the cutting, faceting, and polishing stages, every gemstone undergoes a thorough
quality check to verify dimensions, shape, polish, symmetry, color, clarity, and overall finish.
Each stone is inspected against strict quality standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and
excellence before it is approved for shipment and final packing.

## Secure Packing

Approved gemstones are securely packed using protective materials, including pouches, bubble wrap,
and boxes, to safeguard their quality during transit. Each shipment is carefully labelled, verified,
and prepared according to established packing standards, ensuring safe and reliable delivery to
customers worldwide.

## Ship with Trusted Delivery Partners

Gemstones are securely packed, labeled, and verified before shipment. We work with trusted delivery
partners to ensure safe, timely, and reliable transportation, allowing each order to reach its
destination in perfect condition. Products are shipped worldwide through secure courier services
like UPS Fedex with required documentation.

[[livingston montana agate]][13]

### [Montana][14]

The impressive landscape of Montana makes it an excellent choice for rockhounds. This state offers
an opportunity to collect some amazing agates, jaspers, and petrified wood. Montana is best known
for its incredible blue sapphires and Montana agate.

[[idaho rockhounds]][15]

### [Idaho][16]

A great state for exploring and hunting for rocks and minerals. Idaho has a variety of rockhounding
locations that are perfect for any rockhound.  You'll be digging for and collecting quartz, jasper,
agates, petrified wood and thunder eggs.

[[arizona rockhounds]][17]

### [Arizona][18]

Rockhounding in Arizona is an excellent activity for kids and adults alike. This state offers plenty
of locations for new and old rockhounds. You'll be digging for and collecting Agate, Jasper,
Petrified Wood, and Copper specimens throughout the state.

[[florida rockhounds]][19]

### [Florida][20]

Are you a rockhound looking for an adventure in Florida? It could be the perfect state to explore
and find incredible rocks and minerals. Florida’s rockhound locations are too many to list but
you'll be digging for and collecting petrified wood, quartz, and calcite crystals.

[[arkansas rockhounds]][21]

### [Arkansas][22]

If you want to find the best rockhound locations for Quartz crystals and crystal clusters then
Arkansas should be your number one destination. Learn more about which mine is right for you and
which ones offer the best rockhounding experience.

[[georgia rockhounds]][23]

### [Georgia][24]

Rockhounds can't go wrong prospecting in Georgia because it provides a variety of rocks and minerals
for collectors. You'll dig for and collect corundum, rubies, amethyst, quartz and staurolites

## Crystal & Mineral Locations

[[beryl crystal hogg mine]][25]

### [Hogg Mine][26]

If you’re looking for Rose Quartz, Black Tourmaline, or Aquamarine then this location is a must.
This location is excellent for families, junior rockhounds, and old-timers but keep in mind it is a
paid dig location and you'll need to coordinate with the mine owners.

[[topaz crystal]][27]

### [Topaz Mountain][28]

If you’re looking for Topaz crystals that range in size and color then Topaz Mountain Gem Mine is a
fantastic destination for rockhounds and crystal collectors. It’s located in Lake George, Colorado
but is privately owned so make sure you keep reading to learn how to access the mine.

[[jackson crossroads amethyst crystal]][29]

### [Jackson Crossroads][30]

The JXR Mine in Georgia is known for producing high-quality Amethyst crystals. This mine has turned
into a destination due to the popular YouTube videos about unearthing these unique crystals This
location is excellent for families and junior rockhounds.

[[crystal vista arkansas]][31]

### [Crystal Vista Mine][32]

You’ll dig for and collect Quartz crystal points and clusters at the Crystal Vista mine. It’s just
south of Mount Ida, Arkansas and it’s FREE. This location has been written about in rock & mineral
magazine and there are multiple YouTube videos showing ordinary rockhounds collecting beautiful
Quartz crystals.

[[skeletal quartz diamond hill mine]][33]

### [Diamond Hill Mine][34]

The Diamond Hill Mine provides a rare opportunity to unearth Quartz crystals, Amethyst crystals, and
Smoky Quartz crystals. The mine spans 6 acres with multiple dig locations varying in difficulty.

[[quartz crystal cluster ron coleman]][35]

### [Coleman Crystal Mine][36]

This family-owned mine provides a unique opportunity for rockhounds to dig for their own crystals in
tailings. Don’t worry, fresh hauls are brought up from the mine regularly and you’ll keep everything
you find. Once again, this is an excellent location for families and junior rockhounds.

specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.
